items.title: Fred Moore Interview, 1959-06-19
items.q: Professor Rogashow was playing the violin and Red Happy. I called him Red. He's a great fly drummer, great show drummer.

ctx.x: The Lyric Theater. That's when I first met Professor Rogashow, the violin player. And I think they had about five or six pieces in the pit, probably more than that. I couldn't remember but two of them. Professor Rogashow was playing the violin and Red Happy. I called him Red. He's a great fly drummer, great show drummer. And we stayed there, stayed in the theater two weeks. And we went from the early, we went to Havana, Cuba. We stayed over there around, oh, about three months.
How do you like New Orleans as a city?
